# One role id per line, in dispatch precedence order (ties in selection are
# broken by this order -- see build_dispatch_plan.py's _ordered(), which
# sorts by catalog insertion index). `#` starts a full-line comment; blank
# lines are ignored. This file is the single ordering source for both
# agents/catalog.yaml's role-block order and, once a role is migrated to
# frontmatter, agents/orchestration/src/generate_role_metadata.py's merge of
# that role into the generated files. Caveat: this ordering source governs
# agents/catalog.yaml's key order exactly, but NOT routing.yaml's
# knowledge_focus block -- that block never reorders an already-present
# role and always appends a newly-added role at the very end, regardless of
# where the role sits here (see splice_knowledge_focus()'s docstring in
# generate_role_metadata.py). Regenerate agents/catalog.yaml and
# agents/orchestration/routing.yaml after changing this file:
#
#   python3 agents/orchestration/src/generate_role_metadata.py
#
# Adding a role: add its AGENT.md and add its id here in the position that
# reflects its intended dispatch precedence. Removing a role: remove both.
